title: On number of cyclic $n$-roots and disjointness of Fourier supports
summary: A cyclic $n$-root is an $n$-dimensional complex vector that solves a particular set of multivariate homogeneous polynomial equations. There is a one-to-one correspondence between unimodular cyclic $n$-roots and bi-unimodular vectors (CAZAC sequences) with leading entry one. It was conjectured by Björck and Saffari that the set of cyclic $n$-roots is finite if and only if $n$ is square free. It is known that such a set is infinite if $n$ is not square free, and finite if $n$ is prime.
